svg.desc: Jeddah Heights Sales Center LOCATION Jeddah, KSA CLIENT NHC STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project covers consulting and supervision services for a dedicated sales center for the National Housing Company (NHC) in Jeddah. The scope includes preparing work plans to control time, cost, and quality, supervising execution on site, auditing and approving payment documents, and reviewing all detailed and execution drawings. It also involves reviewing budgets, monitoring the project schedule, overseeing contractor performance, providing technical opinions on variations, and checking materials and equipment.
